mentions.name: Remote team ceremony toolkit
mentions.description: A series of tools that help remote engineering teams run standard ceremonies such as standups, retros, and ice-breakers, designed to bring back a sense of fun, wonder, and connection that has been lost with remote working.
mentions.problem: Standard remote team ceremonies have lost the sense of fun, wonder, and connection in recent times with remote working.
mentions.source_excerpt: I manage remote engineering teams and I'm building a series of tools to help facilitate our standard ceremonies (standups, retros, ice-breakers etc.).

evidence.value: I manage remote engineering teams and I'm building a series of tools to help facilitate our standard ceremonies (standups, retros, ice-breakers etc.).
